assets.name: cupid-subduing-two-lions-in-acanthus-scroll
assets.description: A winged Cupid physically holding two crouching lions, their bodies flowing into the surrounding curled acanthus frieze. Part of the Cupid and Four Seasons acanthus friezes set.

provenance.title: Two Acanthus Friezes: Cupid Subduing Two Lions; Heads of Four Seasons, plate 14 from "Decorative friezes and foliage" (Ornamenti di fregi e fogliami)

extraction.method: Native-resolution continuous ink coverage after locally measured paper removal; PNG appearance master.
extraction.source_rgb_modified: Paper removed by measured ink coverage; RGB is the scan-measured ink tone, not an exact source-pixel crop.

review.approval_scope: Native source-appearance comparison; provisional for maintainer review.
review.notes: Native source ink retained, including curved hatching, leaves, faces, thin draperies, cages and scroll tips. Original architectural beams/rules forming the artwork are retained where they support figures. Actual paper openings are transparent. PNG-only; a trace would lose print grain.

assets.usage_notes: Native ink appearance retained with continuous transparency. This finite original ornament establishes no seamless period; no repeat or corner atlas inferred. SVG withheld where tracing alters the source print grain.
